exam_exercises.text: Part 1 — Multiple Choice (۲۰ نمره — هر سؤال ۲ نمره)

items.question: Humans ______ destroy the natural homes of animals if we don't act now.
Look! The cheetah ______ run into the forest.
We ______ (not/hurt) the injured animal.
______ you ______ protect the environment?
Next year, there ______ be a few more Iranian cheetahs.
Maryam is visiting the museum. She ______ going to learn about wildlife.
If people take care of them, cheetahs ______ live longer.
The number of endangered animals ______ increase in the future.
Families ______ pay more attention to nature these days.
We ______ have clean air in the future if we work hard.

exam_exercises.text: Part 2 — Fill in the Blanks with will or won't (۱۵ نمره — هر جای خالی ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Use words from the lesson: protect, increase, hurt, save, live. Fill in each blank with will or won't and the correct verb form.

items.text: If humans take care of nature, wild animals ______ (increase) in number.
If people cut down trees, endangered animals ______ (not/live) safely.
We ______ (protect) the Iranian cheetah for future generations.
The number of cheetahs ______ (increase) if we help them.

exam_exercises.text: Part 3 — Choose will or be going to (۱۵ نمره — هر سؤال ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form based on the situation.

items.question: Look at those dark clouds! It ______ (rain).
We have already planned our trip. We ______ (visit) Golestan Forest next month.
The phone is ringing! I ______ (answer) it.
Reza has decided already. He ______ (not/watch) TV tonight.
I think people ______ (save) more animals in the future.

exam_exercises.text: Part 4 — Rewrite the Sentences (۱۵ نمره — هر جمله ۵ نمره)

items.text: The children will play in the yard.
answer: The children will not play in the yard.
The children won't play in the yard.

items.text: They are going to protect endangered animals.
answer: Are they going to protect endangered animals?

items.text: Mr. Razavi will teach people to take care of animals.
answer: Who will teach people to take care of animals?

exam_exercises.text: Part 5 — Reading and Choosing the Best Verb Form (۱۵ نمره — هر جای خالی ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Read the paragraph and choose the best verb form.
exam_exercises.passage: Sara is an Iranian student. She likes/will like animals very much. Next month, she and her family travel/will travel to Tooran Plain. They hope/hopes to see the Iranian cheetah there. If they are lucky, they see/will see a few cheetahs. Sara is going to/will take many photos of the wildlife there.

items.question: She ______ animals very much.
Next month, she and her family ______ to Tooran Plain.
They ______ to see the Iranian cheetah there.
If they are lucky, they ______ a few cheetahs.
Sara ______ many photos of the wildlife there.

exam_exercises.text: Part 6 — Matching (۱۰ نمره — هر مورد ۲ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Match column A with column B to make correct sentences.
options: are going to save the forest.

items.answer: are going to save the forest.

exam_exercises.text: Part 7 — Short Writing (۱۰ نمره — خودارزیابی یا با راهنمایی معلم)

exam_exercises.instruction: In 3-4 complete sentences, write about your plans for next weekend and one prediction about the future of nature in Iran. Use at least one sentence with "will" and one sentence with "be going to".

items.sample_answer: Next weekend, I am going to visit my grandparents. We are going to spend time together. I will help them in the garden. I think people will protect nature in Iran.
